jobs.name: Build one application with shared GGML and both Vulkan providers
Linux native Vulkan loader and software-driver inference
Linux application in an empty filesystem
Windows native PE with the identical application

scope.native_linux_driver_kind: host Mesa software Vulkan; llvmpipe LLVM20.1.2

changes: Native and embedded Vulkan instances coexist behind one shared GGML WebGPU backend; per-device ownership and exact selectors propagate into inference.
Provider auto prefers compatible discrete/integrated hardware, then embedded software; native auto requires physical hardware. Explicit native software selection remains available for diagnostics.
Hardware-required diagnostic rejects software and unknown adapter types; incompatible ShaderF16 devices report explicit reasons.
One versioned persistent configuration store serves CLI, Settings, GPU Config and native HTTP options, with validated atomic saves, temporary CLI overrides and restart semantics.
Linux native/auto model loading, HTTP inference and cleanup run on original main for host TLS; internal diffusion-loader workers execute inline. Windows and explicit embedded loading retain workers.
Bounded native adapter enumeration prevents count/fill growth overruns and preserves handle ownership.
